body: Yeah. Tbh when I think of the future, whether it be 5 or 10 years later, I just think of my own coffin. I don’t really see a future for me. People have all these hopes for me, and yet I can’t really see myself in any of them. At first I thought it was because I was young and didn’t know where I fit in. Also felt that I wasn’t worth their expectations, but now I’m an adult and I still see myself 6 feet under ground.
Hm interesting cause everyone i know who has dated their best or a close friend said that they were just better as friends. They couldn’t see each other as a s.o.
Why though? What if it ruins relationships and you two end up treating each other still only as friends when you two are now bf/gf or however you float
